source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_adapters" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i adapters (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the adapter OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_adapters SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Read approved adapter inventory and state through SNMPv3 and correlate it with the expected platform topology.
original_method: Engineer configures v3/WebUI and browses undefined `$target`; source does not say NIC, HBA, storage adapter or management interface.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/SNMPv3 and supplies target adapter class; inventory/query/comparison can then be automated.
safety_requirements: Read only; never change MAC, VLAN, link or management route.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, query mapped adapters and reconcile slot/MAC/WWN/link/state to baseline with redaction.
Do not alter networking or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve adapter scope/map and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Wrong security mode and generic word match cannot prove vendor adapter objects or mapping.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor adapter-table SNMPv3 objects and full typed responses.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select one adapter class, query its identity/status table over v3 and correlate with platform inventory without configuration writes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor adapter MIB and topology guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds adapter class and stable identity mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents unrelated network objects from passing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory may not expose host link details.

project_override_considerations: Project may select NIC, HBA or another adapter class, but must report that scope and omitted classes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Adapter class/map are project inputs; manual configuration followed by automated read-only inventory is executable.
